name: LysaMC
description:
Welcome to LysaMC - A Minecraft Network for Everyone

Something for every player. Multiple game modes, active community and always growing.

Java and Bedrock welcome! Running 1.21+ with cross-version support.

Java: lysamc.net

Bedrock: lysamc.net (Port: 19132)

Discord: discord.gg/Mr4DMjRH4Q

Store: store.lysamc.net

Game Modes:

Skyblock

Build your island from scratch with custom minions, jobs, dungeons, daily rewards,

custom enchants, pets and farming tools. Compete on the island leaderboard!

Anarchy / LifeSteal

No rules, no mercy. PvP with LifeSteal mechanics where you steal hearts

from your enemies. Raid, grief and survive in total freedom.

RPG / Elite Mobs + Dungeons

Adventure through custom dungeons, fight elite bosses and collect epic loot.

Full RPG experience with progression, gear and challenging encounters.

Lobby / Minigames

Your hub to all game modes. Hang out, check crates, and jump into

minigames while you wait for friends.

Network Features:

Cross-server chat and global tab list

Crate keys and vote rewards on every server

Player economy and shops

Skill progression with mcMMO

Java and Bedrock crossplay

Vote daily on sites for free rewards

Friendly community, dedicated host. Join today and start your adventure!
